messages:
maya: Heads-up — hotfix PR #5281 needs 2 approvers before the 18:00 UTC cutover today. Tokenization regression in kv-cache. Can folks pick this up? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/5281
jonah: On it, will do a pass now. Is the rollback plan verified?
maya: rollback is the old kv-cache branch + revert script, tested on staging. I posted the commands in ops-runbook earlier.
sasha: I can do code review but I need CI green and a brief perf sanity check (latency + mem). If both look good I can LGTM.
kevin: I can be second approver after 16:30 UTC. If CI flakes I can run the e2e locally. ping me when CI finishes.
maya: thanks — CI just queued. also, quick ask: if both approvers aren't available by cutoff, can we use the delegated-approver cascade (oncall -> infra-owner -> release-lead)? need to know fallback plan.
jonah: yep that's the plan. cascade only if PR has at least one approver and tests pass. we prefer not to force-merge.
sasha: +1 on that. if jonah gives first LGTM and kevin misses cutoff, escalate to @kevin or oncall.
kevin: if you escalate to me, drop a short summary and the failing tests (if any). I can run `./scripts/run_e2e.sh --filter kv-cache` locally.
maya: CI passed (deploy-bot): 
deploy-bot: build #8342 — ✅ all checks passed — https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/8342
jonah: doing a quick diff now, focusing on `kv_cache.cpp` and the tokenizer shim. small nit: a log line left in, will comment.
sasha: saw jonah's comment — addressed in new commit. re-running unit tests locally, will post perf numbers in 10m.
maya: perf:  p50 +2ms, mem +3% on staging load (small). acceptable for hotfix.
kevin: I gave LGTM on the code change and the perf note. second approver?
jonah: leaving my LGTM for merge. two approvers complete.
maya: awesome — merging now, cutting hotfix window 18:00 UTC. tagging release notes.
deploy-bot: deploy queued to staging and prod-canary at 18:05 UTC. monitor: https://console.redwood-inference/deploys/5281
sasha: will watch metrics post-cutover and report regressions. thanks team :thumbsup:
maya: thanks all — great run. filing a short post-deploy note in #postmortems if anything anomalous shows up.
